Disabling abbreviation expansion keeps tooltip titles out of page text

```php title="PHP"
<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

require_once __DIR__ . '/vendor/autoload.php';

use Crawlberg\Crawlberg;
use Crawlberg\CrawlConfig;
$engine_config = CrawlConfig::from_json(json_encode(["content" => ["expandAbbreviations" => false, "extractMetadata" => false], "respectRobotsTxt" => false]));
$engine = Crawlberg::createEngine($engine_config);
$url = "https://example.com";
$result = Crawlberg::scrape($engine, $url);
var_dump($result->getMarkdown()?->content);
```
